verdict.rationale: The official exa-js SDK documents an `exa.answer()` call under the heading "Get answers with citations", which returns an LLM-generated answer from a single API call. Supporting docs describe grounded synthesis and grounded answers with web citations through the Exa Agent, and search streaming yields OpenAI-style chat completion chunks. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party docs page for the answer endpoint (citation format, model/search options, latency), and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer and citation quality.
